text_block_list.text: —The rain just won't stop.

The rain had been falling continuously for 
several days. The sound of rain beating 
against the roof constantly echoed deep 
within my ears.

Intermittently... continuously... That 
sound obstructs my thoughts, and the 
stifling humidity dulls my tactile 
senses...

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: ...Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
I have completed all of the menu you gave 
me.

"Before we knew it, we were the only ones 
left in the gymnasium."

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: What shall we do next?

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
We still have a little more time, 
however...

A hint of fatigue could be seen on Still 
in Love's face.

It wasn't just fatigue from training. With 
this rain, all the Umamusume had gloomy 
looks on their faces. Right now—

desperately search for words."

D O N ' T S T O P ! !

text_block_list.text:

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: So... don't hold back.

text_block_list.text:
“—Tell me your true desires... just as 
they are.”

Just then—the sound of rain abruptly 
stopped.

text_block_list.text: ...Huh?

exhausted. I must not burden her any

make right now.

yourself like that.

text_block_list.text:
"With this, I'm sure... I must have grown 
just a little bit stronger."

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
"Besides, with this rain... it wouldn't be 
surprising if Trainer's thoughts were 
clouded..."

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: Let's head back. ...I'll go get changed.
—Really?

I glance up at the ceiling. The rain has 
completely stopped, and through the 
window—
—A red full moon was peeking through.
